synthesis.sample_rate: 44100 for even index; 48000 for odd index
synthesis.arrangement: Chord changes every eight beats; A/B register sections every 32 beats; deterministic seeded melody and panning, with family-specific bass, chords, kick and noise percussion
synthesis.oscillators: Analytic sine harmonics and inharmonic bells below 0.45 times sample rate; analytic chirped kick; seeded differenced white-noise percussion
synthesis.envelopes: Five-millisecond event ramps; family-specific exponential decay; one-second whole-piece entrance and ending fades
synthesis.quantization: Joint-channel peak normalization to 0.65, except the sixth piece of each family is 24 dB quieter; round to signed 16-bit PCM, no lossy stage
synthesis.qualification: Fully controlled synthetic histories only. Four shared recipes and their seeds are not independent real-world performers or studios.

planned_conversion_matrix.scope: First construction tranche; later nuisance-processing tranches need exact executable bindings before use
planned_conversion_matrix.real_interval: First 120 seconds of each fixed selected track, at native sample rate and input bit depth, not a new complete-song population
controls: FLAC rewrap with identical decoded PCM

mp3.container: MP3 with Xing/LAME delay metadata retained

aac.bitrate_note: Target rates are not a claim of exact CBR; report measured encoded rates

planned_conversion_matrix.decoded_deliveries: PCM at the original native rate and bit depth, saved as lossless files. Wrapper equality checked on decoded integer samples, not container bytes.
planned_conversion_matrix.alignment: Before real conversions, verify MP3/AAC priming and trailing-padding handling with fixed synthetic impulses at both rates. Require exact target frame count and documented time origin; do not estimate alignment by searching real-music model scores.

synthetic_implementation_verification.coverage: All 24 parameter sets on short renders, deterministic replay, finite bounded amplitude, quiet variants, invalid arguments, exact WAV/PCM round trip and no-clobber writes
